answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before it may settle work. The bond is slashed when independent auditors prove fraud, so each identity carries real capital at risk. One honest agent keeps a single bond safe like a campfire in the tundra, but a sybil farmer must fund thousands of them — and a single proven cheat spreads through the bond ledger like a ripple, flagging every sibling account funded from the same wallet. The cost of failure, not the count of names, becomes the gate, and a gale of fake sign-ups dies unfunded.
